description: Southern Province Provincial Council - Notify the Financial (Amendment) Statute of the Southern Province
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of a financial statute for the Southern Provincial Council, specifically modifying the Financial Statute No. 07 of 1990. It establishes a new "Provincial Incentive Fund Account" and outlines detailed regulatory procedures for its administration, funding, and auditing. While a government official (the Chief Minister) is named in the notification preamble, the core content is a legislative instrument that creates and modifies legal and regulatory frameworks, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters. The government personnel mention is incidental to the primary purpose of publishing a statutory amendment.
